notes:
Uploads wait for your cards, Eject waits for a full check, and footage checks run faster.

- Uploads start once your cards finish copying, so cards are free sooner
- Eject appears only when every file matches the card — or press Eject when verified and it ejects for you
- The Files list updates live while a card copies, and failed files say why
- Footage checks finish faster, and a card that drops out for a moment is retried once
- How files are copied and matched against the card is unchanged
